subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding percent as 'out of 100' and connecting it to hundredths
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student shades a virtual 100-square grid to represent a given percent
exercise.pictorial: Student reads a pictured shaded hundredths grid and states the percent
exercise.abstract: Student writes a percent from a given hundredths fraction and vice versa

misconception_flags: treats percent as a fraction out of any number rather than specifically 100

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
